summary: Use deployed local Validator for onedev publication

delivery.outcome: Operators can publish semcod/koru pull requests locally with standard-pack conformance, OneDev profile gates, and the deployed local Validator exact-head merge path without target-repo GitHub Actions.

architecture.decision: Shell orchestration runs frozen-head conformance checks, waits for the protected local OneDev executor to publish exact-head status against the current main SHA, posts only the script-owned standard-pack status, then invokes the deployed local Validator direct-pr adapter with explicit repository, ticket, exact-head and protected-key arguments.
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge and continue using hosted checks where available.

validation.evidence: The exact checkout passes the local governance gate; protected dry-run remains blocked by the deployed executor image missing /app/docker/pr/check-koru-docs.py.
The protected retry for PR #249 fails before tests because the active executor image lacks the configured Koru checker; the local Validator adapter is not invoked.
